title: Call Center Manager - Develop agents, spam consumers, avoid litigation, and sell your business.
author: garrettcrawbuck
selftext:
[Call Center Manager](https://wellgamed.itch.io/call-center-manager)  
  
I noticed a lot of the games here being posted are probably more impressive (visually), but I had always wanted to make a game about my experiences working as an admin in the call center space. Additionally, I've always been a big management/sim/tycoon fan, and felt the two meshed well together. 

\--

**You start the game by where you'd like to stake your claim** \- Auto Warranty, Home Warranty, or Debt Consolidation. The big 3! Each one is more difficult to start with, and you even get to choose how much cash you'd like to begin with. 

https://preview.redd.it/yrsbn6zz3boh1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=8da6783a10b4476adc20f66ec86ccc812e7e04d8

**Find employees to hire** \- each with their own traits, stats, price tag. If they're great, you can promote them - if they suck, fire them!  


https://preview.redd.it/x6c8dxu34boh1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=1a1c01a96fab856ee28b7c5d0c0e4fe4adb4ba88

**Review your weekly report.** This gives you a full breakdown of your week - from your sales, to cancels. Calls not picked up, to closers waiting for calls. Who developed, what choices you made - It's all in the weekly report! Give thanks your report guy -he's a hard worker and probably deserves a raise. 

https://preview.redd.it/ononwa674boh1.png?width=1100&format=png&auto=webp&s=486c9f7aca21f5993d695980314a6a2e468ff1c7

**Occasionally, you'll need to make some decisions.** Whether a litigator wants money, or a random lead broker is trying to sell you some junk cheap data.

https://preview.redd.it/qqb0xbo94boh1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=753918ae1c6b59a3ee92b08ff6a7e5618dc37b2e

**Sell your business.** Ready to call it quits? See how much you can get acquired for. The ultimate goal - Early retirement!

https://preview.redd.it/1l9d8lme4boh1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=b5165dd60d2a7cfb1fbe1944a562cc0ff7780663
